_comment: GamePanel Minecraft egg. Generated by scripts/minecraft-eggs.sh; edit that, not this file.
name: NeoForge
author: eggs@gamepanel.invalid
description: Modern fork of Forge used by most new modpacks (Minecraft 1.20.2 and newer). Put mods in the mods folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads the server; see images/java/gp-install in the GamePanel repository.
cd /mnt/server
exec gp-install neoforge

variables.name: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). The server does not start until you do.

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: "latest" or a version such as 1.21.11. Changing it takes effect when you reinstall the server.

variables.name: NeoForge version
variables.description: "latest" for the newest stable release, or a version such as 21.1.200. Takes effect when you reinstall.

variables.name: Garbage collector
variables.description: auto picks G1 with tuned flags, and generational ZGC for heaps of 12 GB or more on Java 21+. Leave it on auto unless you are measuring.

variables.name: Extra JVM flags
variables.description: Added after GamePanel's own flags, so they win. Heap size is set from the server's memory limit; do not add -Xmx.

variables.name: Launch profile
variables.description: How gp-java tunes and configures this server.
